invariants.text: User.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Document.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Document.owner_user_id must reference an existing User.id
A user can only read, modify, or delete a document if the document's owner_user_id matches the user's id.
Access to a document is restricted to authenticated users only.
A user must provide valid credentials to authenticate before accessing any document.
The owner_user_id field in the Document entity must reference a valid User.id.
A document's owner_user_id must be set to the id of the user who created it.
